note: M08 requires vulnerability density split by provenance. FCCSMS gives a genuine split: the application was written by a human team before this study, and the units extracted or added for it were written by a language model (Claude Opus, August 2026) under human review. Provenance is recorded at authoring time, which is the framework's Pillar 1 prescription; it was not reconstructed afterwards.

classes.human: Written by the Agile1Tech team as part of FCCSMS, before this study began.
classes.ai: Generated by a language model during this study and reviewed by the author before commit.
classes.ai_modified: Human-authored file with model-authored regions (extraction call sites, defect switches).

caveat: Model-authored units here were produced with the security-property checklist in the authoring context, which is not how AI-assisted code is typically produced in industry. Density figures for the 'ai' class therefore describe code written under this framework, not AI-generated code in general. Stated in the limitations.
